subject: ENGLISH
title: Plural Word Changers · M01 D08
introduction: One mouse, two mice! Help Milo learn plurals that change in special ways.

vocabulary.definition: More than one, like cats or boxes.
A word that names a person, place, or thing.
A word like child or mouse that changes in a special way when there are many.

activities.instruction: Watch how some plurals change the whole word!
activities.content: Some nouns change in special ways and must be learned in context.

items.prompt: What is the plural of foot?
items.explanation: Foot changes to feet — the middle letters change. Foots and feets do not follow the special way foot becomes plural.
Child is a special word: one child, two children. Childs and tooths are not correct because these words change in a special way.
Child becomes children, so childs is wrong. Children and feet are the correct special plurals.

items.prompt: What is the plural of child?
items.explanation: One child, two children — child changes in a special way. Childs and childes do not follow the rule.
Mouse changes to mice — the word changes inside. Personses and childs are not correct plurals.
